🎬 Maudie (2016)

Maudie tells the inspiring true story of Maud Lewis, a Canadian folk artist whose extraordinary talent and determination helped her overcome a lifetime of physical challenges, poverty, and social isolation. Living in rural Nova Scotia during the 1930s, Maud struggles with severe rheumatoid arthritis, which affects her mobility and makes everyday tasks increasingly difficult. Despite being underestimated by her family and the people around her, she dreams of living independently and finding happiness on her own terms. Her life changes when she answers an advertisement for a housekeeper placed by Everett Lewis, a rough and emotionally reserved fish peddler living in a small, isolated house. Although their personalities clash and their relationship begins under difficult circumstances, Maud gradually brings warmth, color, and creativity into Everett’s otherwise lonely world. Using simple paints and everyday materials, she transforms the walls, windows, and household objects around her into beautiful works of art inspired by the natural landscapes and animals of Nova Scotia. As her paintings begin attracting attention, Maud discovers that her artistic passion can provide both personal fulfillment and financial independence. Through emotional struggles, unexpected companionship, and moments of quiet happiness, she proves that extraordinary creativity can flourish even under the most difficult circumstances. Combining beautiful countryside scenery, heartfelt performances, and deeply moving storytelling, Maudie explores love, resilience, independence, creativity, acceptance, and the extraordinary power of finding beauty in life’s simplest moments.

🎭 Genre: Biography • Drama • Romance

⭐ IMDb: 7.6/10

⏱️ Runtime: 1h 55m • PG-13

🎥 Director: Aisling Walsh

✍️ Writer: Sherry White
